**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User's business name is CreativeSpark Marketing.

[FACT] User is focusing on small to medium-sized businesses in the local area for their marketing services.  
[FACT] User's target audience consists of busy entrepreneurs who want to grow their business but lack marketing expertise or resources.  
[PREFERENCE] User wants their tone and voice on social media to be friendly, approachable, and knowledgeable.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a content strategy with the following breakdown: Educational content (40%), Behind-the-scenes (20%), Customer-centric content (20%), Promotional content (10%), Engagement content (10%).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant created a social media calendar for the next 4 weeks with 3 posts per week on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Week 1 social media posts:  
- Monday (Facebook): Educational content - "5 Marketing Mistakes Small Businesses Make" (blog post)
